description: Adversarial dictation — robustness tests with stutter, pauses, reversals, noise, and dropouts

scenarios.name: stutter-short-word
scenarios.description: Brief stutter on a short word — should still produce coherent output

scenarios.name: stutter-long-word
scenarios.description: Heavy stutter on a long word

scenarios.name: pause-mid-sentence
scenarios.description: 500ms pause in the middle of speech — should not derail context

scenarios.name: long-pause
scenarios.description: 2-second pause — pipeline should handle silence gracefully

scenarios.name: reversal-short
scenarios.description: Short segment reversal (restating words) — output should not crash

scenarios.name: light-noise
scenarios.description: Light background noise (30dB SNR) — should still produce intelligible output

scenarios.name: moderate-noise
scenarios.description: Moderate noise (15dB SNR) — challenging but should produce some output

scenarios.name: light-dropout
scenarios.description: 5% packet loss — should barely affect quality

scenarios.name: heavy-dropout
scenarios.description: 20% packet loss — degraded but should not crash

scenarios.name: combined-adversarial
scenarios.description: Stutter + noise + dropout — worst-case dictation scenario

scenarios.name: pause-then-stutter
scenarios.description: Pause followed by stutter — speaker insecurity pattern
